cards.claim: Muon-C reaches substantially lower FID than unfolded Muon and Adam on CIFAR-10 flow matching at 40k iterations with matched applied-update RMS
cards.conditions: CIFAR-10, flow matching task, 40k iterations, with matched applied-update RMS
cards.effect: 9.87 FID (Muon-C) vs 22.26 (unfolded Muon, 2.25× worse) vs 51.31 (Adam, 5.2× worse)
cards.evidence: Empirical results from controlled experiments on CIFAR-10
cards.quote: On CIFAR-10 flow matching with matched applied-update RMS, Muon-C reaches 9.87 FID at 40k iterations, compared with 22.26 for unfolded Muon and 51.31 for Adam.

cards.claim: Muon-C achieves improved FID on CIFAR-10 under equal tuning budgets
cards.evidence: Empirical results from equal-budget optimizer-specific tuning
cards.quote: Under equal tuning budgets, Muon-C obtains 3.42 FID on CIFAR-10, compared with 3.54 for unfolded Muon and 3.83 for Adam.

cards.claim: Muon-C shows stronger early-training trajectory than spatial-blocked Muon-S on convolutional kernels
cards.conditions: Matched comparison between Muon-C (frequency-wise blocking) and Muon-S (spatial-offset blocking)
cards.effect: Frequency-wise blocks show stronger early trajectory compared to spatial-offset blocks
cards.evidence: Matched empirical comparison between two block-partition strategies
cards.quote: A matched comparison with Muon-S, based on the spatial-block Conv2D duality map of Bernstein and Newhouse (2025), shows a stronger early trajectory for translation-frequency blocks than for spatial-offset blocks.

cards.claim: Muon-C reaches baseline model final quality on CIFAR-10 with fewer FLOPs than unfolded Muon and Adam
cards.conditions: CIFAR-10, reaching 400k-step baseline final quality level
cards.effect: 38% and 36% reduction in model FLOPs compared to unfolded Muon and Adam respectively
cards.evidence: Empirical FLOPs accounting from CIFAR-10 flow matching experiments
cards.quote: It reaches the baselines' 400k-step final quality using only and their model FLOPs, respectively, corresponding to savings of 38% and 36%.

cards.claim: Muon-C improves both early-training and final-tuned FID on ImageNet-1k-32 over unfolded Muon
cards.conditions: ImageNet-1k-32, generative task, 40k-step checkpoint and final tuned performance
cards.effect: 21.14 and 12.02 FID (Muon-C) vs 28.02 and 13.24 (unfolded Muon) for 40k and final respectively
cards.evidence: Empirical results on intermediate-resolution ImageNet variant
cards.quote: On ImageNet-1k-32, it improves both the 40k-step FID and the tuned final FID, reaching 21.14 and 12.02 compared with 28.02 and 13.24 for unfolded Muon.

cards.claim: Muon-C achieves highest validation accuracy on ImageNet-100 classification across multiple ResNet and ConvNeXt architectures
cards.conditions: ImageNet-100, classification task, ResNet-34, ResNet-50, ConvNeXtV2-T
cards.effect: Highest accuracy across three architectures with different training histories
cards.evidence: Empirical classification accuracy on ImageNet-100 across architectures
cards.quote: On ImageNet-100, Muon-C attains the highest validation accuracy across ResNet-34, ResNet-50, and ConvNeXtV2-T despite their widely different exposure to the convolutional optimizer route.
